responsibility: Computes and maintains the function-size, time, stack, and call-site summaries consumed by IPA inlining and cloning decisions. It analyzes GIMPLE bodies, estimates costs in context, streams and merges summaries for LTO, and updates or frees the cached function and edge summaries used by later IPA passes.
same_name_distinction: Provides the executable side of ipa-fnsummary: it walks GIMPLE and callgraph edges to build, stream, merge, free, and update inlining cost summaries, and registers the local/IPA passes. In contrast to gcc/ipa-fnsummary.h, it is the analysis and pass implementation, not the summary type/interface declarations.
